bio: The glamorous Westerwood Hotel & Golf Resort houses one of the most exciting fine-dining experiences in Glasgow and they now offer a delicious Afternoon Tea package for guests to enjoy.  The interior of both the hotel and the restaurant is opulent and grand, with splashes of purple and green and huge chandeleirs offering a decadent vibe. Relax and enjoy the surroundings in the knowledge that Westerwood is well-versed in providing a special experience for guests.  The venue offers gorgeous homemade scones and pastries, plus a variety of delicate finger sandwiches and indulgent sweet treats.  You would be surprised to learn that this idyllic retreat is mere minutes away from Glasgow, with regular transport links to the city centre.
